decision_tree.how_to_read: Fixed question order; each node shows how many of the 65 models remain and the next question's answers with their counts. `dead_end:true` = that answer leaves 0 models (don't offer it on that path). Models supporting several answers (e.g. IP & 2-Draht, or multiple button counts) appear under each, so option counts can sum to more than the parent. Branches stop at <=2 models and list the remaining SKUs.

spec_structuring_recommendation.why: The specs that most drive an intercom choice exist only as prose in the product description (tartikel.cBeschreibung), not as structured data — so the finder cannot filter on them. Turning 6-8 of these into JTL Merkmale is the single biggest unlock: the finder could then ask the questions customers actually have (HD camera? night vision? app? weatherproof?).
